import random


class Solution:

    def __init__(self, head: Optional[ListNode]):
        self.head = head

    def getRandom(self) -> int:
        # Reservoir sampling
        result = None
        current = self.head
        n = 0
        while current:
            n += 1
            if randint(1, n) == 1:
                result = current.val
            current = current.next
        return result
